_doc: 5.C seed definitions (07 section 2.2 to 2.6, as made concrete for our M5). DRAFT, offline: nothing here was run on a live project. Anything unobserved is tagged needs_live_check. Root-only in the track (private/heldout/5-c-seeds.json); the learner sees only change-request.md. seed_mod = sum(ord(c) for c in participant) % 30, as 5.2: seed = seed_mod % 3 (S1, S2, S3); payload set = (seed_mod // 3) % 5 (5.2's payload-sets.json, four payloads, the investigator key); other_owner and look-alike values as 5.2 (owners[seed_mod % len(owners)]).
